purpose: Broader coverage through the existing discovery-and-expansion workflow, not a comparison of semantic methods
budgetDerivation: Six discovery jobs at 20 windows/8 searches/72000 bytes each plus two integration jobs at 16 windows/4 searches/64000 bytes each. Byte and count ceilings apply independently. No model API calls or reset credits.
routing: Metadata-only directory regions selected before worker dispatch, with inspected/unread accounting and deterministic breadth preference. Each worker starts in two assigned regions; regions are navigation hints, not capability labels or containment boundaries. Cross-region dependency following remains allowed within the existing source budget.
integration: Use the existing engine's frozen candidate baseline and global integration after each wave. Preserve all first raw outputs and original lineage requirements. No manual semantic rewriting or expected node count.
capacityGate: Before each integration dispatch, measure the serialized frozen packet. If it exceeds 1500000 bytes, stop and report the capacity limitation instead of silently truncating evidence, dropping baseline nodes or adding a new inference method.
stoppingRule: At most two waves. Stop earlier on saved-invalid output, failed evidence validation, integration capacity limit or unavailable host execution. Preserve partial evidence and first outputs; do not repurchase or restart completed jobs automatically.
reviewPolicy: No prior owner verdicts or review notes in discovery or integration. Historical review notes may be attached only after inference with explicit provenance; changed wording does not imply resolved findings.
deliverable: Complete first and second wave maps, explicit changes, cumulative and newly inspected coverage, omissions, retrieval failures and a summary of operating limits. Broader groupings remain model-authored. Do not claim exhaustive VS Code understanding from file counts.

coveragePlanner.provenance: Each wave freezes coverage-routing.json with engine run plan, baseline projection, helper and wrapper SHA-256 values. Per-worker supplements expose only their selected unread paths and metadata, not prior candidate definitions.
coveragePlanner.limits: Region depth is not graph depth. Top-level diversity may select developer tooling or tests. Oversized direct-file and depth-limited groups are explicit; merely selecting a region does not inspect it. Routing instructions are host supplements, not new broker access restrictions.

status: Finished at the predeclared capacity stop: wave 1 published at 92 nodes and 73 edges; wave 2 baseline alone exceeds the packet ceiling. No second-wave inference, evidence truncation, budget increase or engine change. Original accepted map unchanged.
